text: OpenAI's advertising business reached a $1B annualized revenue run rate roughly 200 days after launch. ChatGPT Ads operate in 40+ countries across free and Go tiers, with self-service access expanding across India, Europe, the Middle East, and North Africa.

meta.note: Advertising spans platform monetization and geographic distribution.

text: A five-justice Supreme Court majority allowed White House ballroom construction to continue, citing likely lack of plaintiff standing. Roberts and three liberal justices dissented. Congressional authorization remains unresolved while litigation continues.

meta.note: The order addresses standing and construction status, not the underlying statutory-authority question.

text: Venezuela granted NABEP 100-year concessions for 17 fields with about 65B barrels of proven reserves. A U.S. government office holds 35% of NABEP'S parent, with guaranteed access to 20% of output at production cost and first refusal on the remainig 80%.

meta.note: The arrangement combines concession, equity, and purchasing structures across state and private entities.
